# Which SHAPES of naming $http_response_header raise php's compile-time deprecation.
# Each case is its own file: the flag php keeps is per compilation context, so two cases in one
# file would contaminate each other — which is the whole point of the write case below.
cd "$(dirname "$0")" || exit 1
mkdir -p hrh_cases
run() {
  name="$1"; body="$2"
  printf '%s' "$body" > "hrh_cases/$name.php"
  out=$(php -n "hrh_cases/$name.php" 2>/dev/null | grep -c "is deprecated")
  warn=$(php -n "hrh_cases/$name.php" 2>/dev/null | grep -c "Undefined variable")
  printf '%-26s deprecated=%s  unde
